emma (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — capturing open Qs on sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partner asks. Drop concise items and tag owners.
raj (VP Sales): High level: we're seeing a bigger mix of partner-influenced opportunities — currently ~18% of pipeline. Main ask: clarity on deal ownership / credit splits for partner-sourced leads.
sam (AE): Can we get a clear doc: when a partner intro -> AE owns, when partner co-sells -> split? Also: who sets discounts for partner deals?
olivia (GTM Lead): Short answer: AE owns direct-sourced; partner-sourced gets partner credit + AE overlay. Discount approvals: >20% needs RevOps + Sales leader sign-off. I'll link the policy.
mike (RevOps): I'll publish the short rubric by EOD. Also proposing a simple tracker in SFDC to tag partner source and partner motion (intro/assist/co-sell).
ana (CS): For onboarding: partner-sourced customers often expect faster handoffs. Can we standardize a 3-day SLA for kickoff after close?
marco (Partnerships): +1 to 3-day kickoff. We're working on a partner onboarding playbook — aiming beta with the first three partners by end of quarter.
sam (AE): Also: trial credits for partner-led demos — can partners get extended trial pool? It helps in POCs.
olivia (GTM Lead): We're testing a partner trial allocation (50k tokens/month shared pool) as a pilot. If you have high-velocity POCs, DM me the partner names.
emma (CEO): High-level ask to leadership: please flag any dependencies blocking partner scale (legal templates, marketplace listings, pricing guardrails) so we can prioritize.
raj (VP Sales): Legal: partner MSA template is in legal queue. Marketplace: we plan to list in 2 phases — cloud marketplace (Q2) then CP partner portal (Q3).
mike (RevOps): Pricing guardrails — I'll add a single-page decision tree for discount approvals and partner incentives.
marco (Partnerships): Quick Q: will Dedicated customers count as partner-sourced for referral fees if sold through partner channel?
olivia (GTM Lead): Yes, if partner handled the intro and is in the opportunity chain, they qualify. We'll codify threshold conditions in the rubric.
sam (AE): Thanks. Who's the single point for urgent pricing exceptions this week? I have a deal that needs quick approval.
mike (RevOps): @sam escalate to me directly. I'll triage and loop in Raj if needed.
recording-bot: Meeting recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.slack.link/recordings/all-hands-1912109876
emma (CEO): Great thread. Olivia and Mike, please post the partner rubric + discount tree here when ready. We'll reconvene in next partner sync. :thumbsup:
